title: SME - Phd in STEM
description:
We are looking for highly qualified PhD holders with python, faculty members and experienced Subject Matter Experts for specialized, project-based assignments involving scientific research, STEM problem-solving, scientific reasoning, AI response evaluation, technical content development and subject-matter validation . 
 Key Responsibilities Conduct advanced research and scientific analysis. Create and validate complex STEM problems and solutions. Develop research workflows, evaluation criteria and technical content. Evaluate AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy and reasoning. Perform literature reviews and evidence-based analysis. Provide specialized subject-matter validation and technical expertise. Required Qualifications Completed PhD in a relevant STEM discipline, such as Physics, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Working knowledge of at least one programming language, preferably Python, R, MATLAB, or C++. Demonstrable experience applying programming in doctoral research or professional projects. Experience in computational analysis, simulations, data processing, numerical methods, or algorithm development. Ability to independently develop or modify code rather than relying exclusively on prebuilt software. 
 Technical Skills Essential Skills Programming: Python, R, MATLAB, C++, C, Java, or Julia. Research coding: Custom scripts, computational research projects, and algorithm implementation. Data analysis: Data processing, statistical analysis, and research dataset analysis. Scientific computing: Computational modelling, numerical methods, or simulations. 
 Additional / Preferred Skills Data analysis libraries: Pandas, NumPy, and SciPy. Machine learning and AI: Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, deep learning, or NLP, depending on project requirements. Software development: Git/GitHub, debugging, testing, algorithms, and data structures. Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Automation: Research workflow automation and data pipelines. High-performance computing: Linux, HPC, parallel computing, CUDA, or cloud computing, where relevant. 
 Candidate Experience Levels Level 1 Basic Coding: Uses programming for research calculations, plotting, basic statistical analysis, and simple scripts. Level 2 Intermediate / Research Coding: Develops research scripts, implements algorithms, performs advanced data analysis, builds simulations, and automates workflows. Level 3 – Advanced Coding: Develops complex software, optimizes algorithms, writes tested code, works with large datasets, and applies software engineering practices. 
 CV Screening Criteria Candidates will be evaluated based on: Completion of a PhD in a relevant STEM discipline. Proficiency in at least one programming language. Practical coding experience in research or professional projects. Experience with computational analysis, simulations, data processing, or algorithm development. Evidence of independently developing or modifying code, supported by specific projects, research work, or professional achievements. 
 Important: Merely listing Python, MATLAB, or another programming language in the CV is not sufficient. Candidates should demonstrate how they used programming to solve research problems or achieve measurable outcomes. Suitable Candidate Profiles STEM PhD researchers with hands-on programming experience. Computational scientists and scientific programmers. Researchers experienced in numerical modelling and simulations. STEM researchers with strong data analysis and automation skills. Advanced coding candidates with software development or AI/ML experience, where relevant to the project. 
 Mandatory Resume Details Full Name | Highest Qualification | Specialization/Research Area | Current Designation | Relevant Experience | Research Experience | Publication Details | Google Scholar URL | H-index | LinkedIn URL | Contact Number | Email ID

title: Support Operations Lead
description:
Support Operations Lead Job Description
 
 Support Operations Lead
 Role Overview
 We are hiring a Support Operations Lead to own the operations side of customer support. You will pair with
 our Support Product Manager, and the two of you will own Support as a function together: you own how
 support runs, they own the products and tools it runs on.
 Your goal is simple to state and hard to do: learners get fast, correct, friendly help, and the support team
 runs on clear processes and the right metrics.
 
 Position Details
 Employment Type Full Time
 Experience 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, at manager level or
 above, in a consumer (B2C) product company
 Location Remote, Kolkata (preferred)
 Work Days 5 Days (official). Weekend work may be required depending on business
 requirements, as this is a Support position.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 What you will do
 • Own support operations end to end: queues, routing, SLAs, escalations, staffing and shift planning.
 • Pick the metrics that matter (first response time, resolution time, first contact resolution, CSAT, ticket
 volume per learner, backlog) and review them every week.
 • Design and document support processes, macros and escalation paths, and keep them current as the
 product changes.
 • Find the top reasons learners contact us, and work with the Support PM and other product teams to
 remove them at the source.
 • Work with the Support PM on bots, self-serve help and tooling. Bring the ground truth from the floor
 into what gets built.
 • Run quality: ticket audits, feedback loops and training for agents, including training on new product
 changes.
 • Lead and grow the support team leads, and build a culture of ownership and care for the learner. 
 What you bring
 • 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, with at least part of that as a manager or above, in
 a consumer (B2C) product company.
 • You have owned support metrics and can show a time you improved them, with the before and after
 numbers.
 • You have designed support processes from scratch or fixed broken ones: routing, SLAs, escalation,
 QA.
 • Hands-on with helpdesk and support tools (for example Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar) and
 with spreadsheets for analysis.
 • Comfortable working with product and tech teams, and able to turn a support problem into a clear ask.
 • Calm under pressure, with high volumes and a large, varied learner base.
 Nice to have
 • Edtech, subscriptions or other high-volume consumer services.
 • Experience rolling out chatbots, AI agents or self-serve help centres.
 • Support in multiple Indian languages.
 
 About be10X
 At be10X (Goenka Kachave LLP), we don't just teach AI – we turn it into a career weapon. We're an AI
 upskilling platform built to help working professionals unlock faster promotions, bigger salary hikes,
 sharper productivity, and career breakthroughs they didn't think were possible yet.
 Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, we've rewritten the career
 trajectories of over 5 million learners through cutting-edge programs spanning AI, Finance, Data, Product,
 and Business.
 And we're not just growing – we're scaling fast. A profitable, fully bootstrapped organization with INR
 500+ crore in annual recurring revenue, a 2,500+ member team, and 15 offices across Pune, Bengaluru &
 Kolkata, we're one of India's – and the globe's – fastest-growing EdTech organizations.   
 The Be10x Effect
 • Google's Official Stamp of Approval – Be10x is a certified Google partner, putting us in a league
 most training platforms only dream of reaching.
 • From Classrooms to Warships – We delivered classified-ready AI training for the Indian Navy: a
 2-day program covering Excel + AI and Power BI dashboards with AI-powered decision briefs, built
 around a strict "data never leaves the laptop" security framework.
 • Now Streaming: Our Own Success Story – Be10x's journey is featured on JioHotstar's "Bharat of
 My Dreams" (2026) – proof that we're not just building careers, we're telling their stories.
 • Star-Studded Sessions – Our stages have hosted names like Boman Irani, Ashneer Grover, and
 Imtiaz Ali, because we believe AI education deserves the same spotlight as prime-time TV.
 • Community First – Proud partners and contributors of the Ahmedabad Rotary Association, Assam
 Chief Minister Office (CMO) contributing to initiatives that create meaningful social and professional
 impact.
 • AI Masterclass with Rotary Ahmedabad – Be10x led the “Orenda Skyline AI Masterclass” at Pandit
 Deendayal Auditorium, Ahmedabad, with 500+ industrialists, professionals, Rotarians and students.
 • Assam Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Assam floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Bihar Flood Relief – Be10x contributed 10 lakh toward relief missions during the Bihar floods,
 supporting on-ground recovery efforts for affected communities.
 • Official AI Partner – Afghanistan Cricket Board – Be10x is now the Official AI Partner of the
 Afghanistan Cricket Board, applying practical AI tools and workflows to support the board’s teams and
 operations.
 Part of House of EdTech
 be10X is part of House of EdTech, a multi-entity upskilling group whose brands include Office Master, AI for
 Techies, Dr. Finance, Profit Uni, and SpringPad.

description:
Role & responsibilities Lead the design, development, training, and deployment of machine learning models to solve complex business problems. Define machine learning strategies, technical roadmaps, and best practices aligned with organizational objectives. Manage and mentor a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists, fostering technical excellence and innovation. Oversee the end-to-end ML lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, experimentation, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Develop and optimize predictive models, classification algorithms, recommendation systems, and forecasting solutions. Drive the adoption of deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and generative AI techniques where appropriate. Establish MLOps practices to automate model training, testing, deployment, versioning, and monitoring. Collaborate with data engineering, software engineering, product, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable ML solutions. Monitor model performance, accuracy, data drift, bias, and reliability, implementing improvements as required. Optimize model performance, inference latency, scalability, and computational costs in production environments. Evaluate emerging ML frameworks, algorithms, tools, and technologies to improve model effectiveness and development efficiency. Ensure adherence to data privacy, security, responsible AI, and model governance standards.  Design data quality, deduplication, validation, and schema-evolution strategies for

 3.2 Data Engineering Architecture (Secondary)

About the Role We are looking for a Sr and Jr Machine Learning Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and continuously improve machine learning models that solve complex business problems using large-scale structured and unstructured data. The ideal candidate will have strong experience building production-grade machine learning systems, developing predictive and behavioural models, performing advanced analytics, and collaborating with data engineering and software development teams to operationalize AI solutions. This role requires a combination of machine learning expertise, software engineering skills, data science knowledge, and cloud deployment experience. 
 Key Responsibilities Design, develop, train, validate, and optimize machine learning models. Build classification, regression, clustering, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, and forecasting models. Perform feature engineering, feature selection, model tuning, and model evaluation. Conduct experimentation and statistical analysis to improve model performance. Develop models that identify behavioural patterns, trends, anomalies, and relationships within large datasets. Develop predictive models using historical data. Build scoring frameworks and risk prediction models. Develop propensity, segmentation, and forecasting models. Develop graph-based analytics and relationship detection models. Perform hyperparameter tuning and model optimization. Compare model performance across different algorithms and approaches. Continuously improve accuracy, precision, recall, and explainability. Deploy machine learning models into production environments. Implement model monitoring, performance tracking, drift detection, retraining, and version control. Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models into production systems and APIs. Work closely with Data Engineers to define data requirements and data quality standards. Collaborate with Software Engineers to operationalize machine learning solutions. Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into machine learning solutions. 
 Required Skills & Experience Strong experience designing, training, validating, and deploying machine learning models. Hands-on experience with classification, clustering, anomaly detection, predictive modelling, and scoring models. Strong understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning. Advanced Python and Strong SQL and data analysis skills. Experience with one or more of these frameworks- Scikit-Learn XGBoost / LightGBM / TensorFlow/ PyTorch Experience working with large datasets and building data-driven solutions. Familiarity with Spark / PySpark is preferred. Experience deploying machine learning solutions on AWS. Familiarity with S3, Lambda, SageMaker, and cloud-based ML workflows. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, model deployment, and model monitoring. 
 Ideal Candidate 5-10yrs+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments. Proven experience taking machine learning solutions from data exploration and model development through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Strong practical expertise in Python, SQL, and modern machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Demonstrated experience working with large-scale datasets and solving complex analytical problems using machine learning techniques. Strong understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, model explainability, and performance optimization. Experience collaborating with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams to operationalize machine learning solutions. Comfortable working independently, conducting experiments, validating hypotheses, and translating ambiguous business problems into data-driven solutions. Strong software engineering discipline, including version control, testing, documentation, and production deployment practices. Experience with cloud-based machine learning environments, preferably AWS. 
 Highly Preferred Experience in behavioural analytics, anomaly detection, predictive scoring, entity resolution, graph analytics, or network analysis. Experience building production-grade machine learning systems that directly influence business decisions or operational workflows. Experience working in highly regulated, data-intensive, or transaction-intensive environments.

Key Skills: behavioural analytics,Performance Optimization,Machine learning models,Anomaly Detection,AWS Sagemaker,Tensorflow,Data Exploration,Machine learning solutions
